title: Implement Asset Purchase: Aset+Kas/Bank- for assets, Expense for non-assets
completion_summary: Implemented Asset Purchase system: assets → Aset+/Kas-, non-assets → Expense, proper double-entry journal entries
acceptance_criteria: Asset purchase creates Aset+ entry (debit to asset account)
Asset purchase creates Kas/Bank- entry (credit from payment source)
Non-asset purchases go directly to Expense account
Asset tracking includes purchase date, value, depreciation status
